mentions.claim_text: He prays that God is with the president and giving him supernatural wisdom on how to deal with Iran, Cuba, the nation and the finances, and thanks God as he humbles himself.
mentions.quote: giving him supernatural wisdom on how to deal with Iran, how to deal with Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Decisions on Iran and Cuba that later look well judged.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not want to advertise a book because it is very dark but that it is what he sees, and speaks about levels of prayer and the range of things people say he sees.
mentions.quote: I don't want to advertise it. It's a very dark book
mentions.falsify_match: The book's content is later matched to events.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not; he withholds it.

mentions.claim_text: He apologises for audio problems, says he does not want to waste anyone's time, and is told seventy three per cent of the audience do not want him to start over.
mentions.quote: 73% say they don't want you to
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a production aside.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He refers back to an onyx thing coming that the Lord was showing him, asks whether he has made it clear enough, and tells the audience to ask the Lord what it is.
mentions.quote: onyx thing coming. And so, the Lord was showing me
mentions.falsify_match: The onyx image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; he hands the interpretation to the audience.

mentions.claim_text: He says there will be three major hubs of churches in Cuba and new businesses raised up, and that he saw a new waterfront and a marine park with roller coasters and an amusement park as a cruise destination.
mentions.quote: I saw a new SeaWorld coming to Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: A marine park and cruise development built in Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He plays the secretary of state saying America has a lot of expertise on Cuba, that the agency is there and that his own parents came from Cuba.
mentions.quote: We have a lot of expertise in Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: An American operation on Cuba proceeds.

mentions.claim_text: He plays an official saying the regime has to end, that they want the former leader and the family in jail but that if they leave they leave, and that the next step is working with whatever remains.
mentions.quote: the regime has to end
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban government falls.

mentions.claim_text: He plays an official saying the economic changes offered are cosmetic and not real because the government has been buying time and waiting America out, and that they will not be able to this time.
mentions.quote: They're not going to be able to wait us out or buy time
mentions.falsify_match: American pressure forces a change in Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him to intercede for the president, and that they had a lead case with a device that could not be detected by sniffers, given to them by the Russian government from the 1960s missile crisis.
mentions.quote: a device that could not be sniffed out by our sniffers
mentions.falsify_match: A shielded Soviet era device is found in Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was all inside the mountain with hundred dollar bills, that the leader put it on a boat rather than flying, went to the Dominican Republic through a system in Cuba to get away, and that the Mexican president hid him at a resort.
mentions.quote: He didn't fly out. He went to the Dominican Republic
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban leader flees by that route.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw dark agency projects worse than waterboarding in those rooms, that he saw very dark things, and that the Lord said he was exposing them.
mentions.quote: I saw projects that were dark that were like worse than waterboarding
mentions.falsify_match: Documented exposure of such a programme.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him not to underestimate the enemy because they are cocky, and that they have a stronghold of people in blue uniforms who are the resistance because they are loyal to the Castros and the leadership.
mentions.quote: they have a stronghold of people with blue uniforms
mentions.falsify_match: Organised armed resistance to an American operation in Cuba.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were connected to Colombia and Venezuela like bosses, that he saw a free Cuba coming, and prays over service personnel going in at night with technology he has never seen, as it went dark.
mentions.quote: they was connected to Colombia and Venezuela. They were like bosses
mentions.falsify_match: A night operation against Cuba beginning with a blackout.

mentions.claim_text: He says these are things they have prayed over for a while and now see in the news, that it has not happened yet but they see the birthing pains, and that it is pretty accurate so far.
mentions.quote: it hasn't happened yet, but we see the birthing pains of it
mentions.falsify_match: The Cuban material lands as described.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He states plainly that it has not happened yet, which is the honest form.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when the day comes they will remember the Lord said it rather than him, that it is always attract to deflect and about giving glory to Jesus, and repeats that in the days ahead he did not see America striking but Israel.
mentions.quote: The Lord said it, not Brandon
mentions.falsify_match: Israel strikes Iran without American participation.
mentions.falsify_miss: America participates, which is what the record of the 2026 campaign shows.

mentions.claim_text: He describes something yellow that was sprayed, trucks coming out of the mountain and brought across Syria into Damascus and across the top of Iraq, in fifty gallon drums.
mentions.quote: they were 50-gallon drums
mentions.falsify_match: Chemical material moved from Iran into Syria in drums.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is found. He hedges the country, saying he believes it is Syria.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that Iran be liberated and says the Lord will bring a great revival to Iran and shake it so the underground church rises and has a window, with an instruction to pray for the grey headed man.
mentions.quote: I'm bringing a great revival to Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised religious movement in Iran.

mentions.claim_text: He says a new leader is coming up out of Iran, that when this happened the prince of Persia shrank back for a season, and that he saw Iraq and blessing rising, noting that he goes over these words a lot.
mentions.quote: the prince of Persia shrunk back for a season
mentions.falsify_match: An Iranian leadership change followed by Iraqi ascendancy.

mentions.claim_text: He says he rehashes everything he can remember so the audience will remember it because he believes it will come to pass, and turns to praying over a Chinese invasion of Taiwan.
mentions.quote: I believe in my heart it will come to pass
mentions.falsify_match: China moves on Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know whether unity is being shown, and points to a report that men were on a hidden assignment to attack Israel.
mentions.quote: These men were on a hidden assignment to attack Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A covert cell targeting Israel is confirmed.
mentions.falsify_miss: The report does not hold up.

mentions.claim_text: He says they were praying for a pastor in California and that God showed them he would be used on the West Coast as a place of revival like Azusa Street, and that God is going to do something with him.
mentions.quote: a place of revival like Azusa Street
mentions.falsify_match: A revival at that named church.

mentions.claim_text: He names the Californian pastor, mentions the worship there, and says they also saw something concerning a named minister and finances.
mentions.quote: Pastor Joe Sweet. Worship kind of worship
mentions.falsify_match: That named church becomes a revival centre.

mentions.claim_text: He prays covering from the top of the head to the soles of the feet, declares the antichrist spirit that tries to come on him will not, and that angels are camped around him.
mentions.quote: that antichrist spirit that tries to come on him is not going to
mentions.falsify_match: The president resists a decision he had warned about.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. The prayer covers both outcomes.

mentions.claim_text: He asks why churches must hold chicken fries to raise money for youth buildings, says the money should be there, and that the Lord said something about a state of the art youth building.
mentions.quote: Why do we have to have chicken fries to try to raise money
mentions.falsify_match: The building is funded without fundraising.

mentions.claim_text: He asks who would write a fifty eight million dollar cheque if God told them to and they were a billionaire, and whether God could trust them with it or they would choke on it.
mentions.quote: Who wants to write a $58 million check?
mentions.falsify_match: A gift of that scale is received.

mentions.claim_text: He quotes that the generation of the upright shall be blessed and that wealth and riches shall be in the house of the righteous, correcting himself mid-verse.
mentions.quote: Wealth and riches shall be in the house of the righteous
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a scripture quotation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He describes more children than he could count being transported from Mexico into America as trafficking in something like a cattle container, and says they were interceding for them to be found by border patrol.
mentions.quote: they were being transported to the America from Mexico as trafficking
mentions.falsify_match: A large trafficking interdiction at the border.

mentions.claim_text: He says they prayed for a kink in the trafficking to stop it, that judgment is coming on this and the Lord is shaking America and the nations, and that they will keep praying.
mentions.quote: there's judgment coming on this and the Lord is shaking America
mentions.falsify_match: A major trafficking exposure and a national shaking.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is not a financial adviser, that people try to label him, that he is just himself and that this is for entertainment purposes only.
mentions.quote: This is for your entertainment purposes only
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a disclaimer.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss, though it sits oddly against material given as from the Lord.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them he saw three scientists and the leader in a black head covering talking to a man with a white beard, asking whether it is time for the Mahdi to come and whether they can bring it forth by striking Israel.
mentions.quote: Is it time for the Mahdi to come?
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian leadership acts to precipitate the Mahdi by striking Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a black rocket with the payload of the atomic bomb used on Japan, and heard the scientist say in English that they only have one, it has never been tested, and they believe it will work.
mentions.quote: We only have one, but it's never been tested
mentions.falsify_match: Iran is confirmed to hold a single untested device.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw that he did not want a two-state solution and that they were bringing in somebody who did in order to divide Jerusalem, that he saw the plan and the darkness coming, and that the Lord said they must pray.
mentions.quote: they were bringing in somebody who did. Trying to divide Jerusalem
mentions.falsify_match: A leadership change in Israel producing a two-state agreement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw space wars with major satellites attacking other satellites using lasers, and compares it to the Hawaii fires where houses with blue roofs did not burn.
mentions.quote: I saw major satellites attacking other satellites in space with lasers
mentions.falsify_match: Confirmed satellite to satellite attacks.

mentions.claim_text: He notes they are striking asteroids and says he told them the rocks would travel so fast they would have to hit them with a green laser, and that it was green.
mentions.quote: these rocks will travel so fast they'll have to hit them with a green
mentions.falsify_match: A laser is used against an incoming object.

mentions.claim_text: He says the area between Portland and Seattle with British Columbia as part of it could represent an earthquake, because the Lord has spoken several times about a quake hitting that area with devastation in British Columbia.
mentions.quote: I believe that could represent an earthquake
mentions.falsify_match: A Cascadia earthquake with British Columbian devastation.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. He offers this as his own reading rather than as given.

mentions.claim_text: He mentions the Canadian prime minister, and says a viewer corrected him that the named car maker did not take the last bailout while the rest of the industry did.
mentions.quote: Ford didn't take the bailout last time
mentions.falsify_match: That manufacturer seeks government support.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw them asking for twenty four billion dollars in government stimulus because the car industry is in trouble, and that he has no idea when, whether years or six months, and does not want to add to it.
mentions.quote: I saw them asking for $24 billion for a government stimulus
mentions.falsify_match: An American car industry bailout request of that size.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is made. The same twenty four billion figure appears elsewhere in this corpus on two unrelated claims.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw two more named manufacturers asking for help and a share of the money as well.
mentions.quote: I saw Chevrolet and GMC asking for help, too
mentions.falsify_match: Multiple manufacturers seek support together.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are not trained soldiers, that there are women who will take up arms, and that they will be pushed out front and slaughtered, adding that if it happens that way it is terrible.
mentions.quote: They're going to just push them out front and they'll be slaughtered
mentions.falsify_match: Untrained conscripts including women used as first wave infantry.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a black and white missile with a round ball at the end covered in octagons that looked like eyes.
mentions.quote: all these octagons looked like they had eyes on this missile
mentions.falsify_match: A weapon of that description is shown.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord said the mountain will glow, that he saw it glowing only in that mountain, and that it was not America but Israel that did it because America was not able to.
mentions.quote: it was not America, it was Israel. America was not able to
mentions.falsify_match: Israel alone strikes the Iranian mountain facility.
mentions.falsify_miss: America strikes it, which is what the record of the 2026 campaign shows.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Israel finishing the job and that America will not, that America will save face by injecting the economy with a great stimulus, and asks his co-host to confirm he remembers.
mentions.quote: I say Israel finishes the job. America will not
mentions.falsify_match: Israel completes the campaign without American strikes.
mentions.falsify_miss: America strikes, which is what happened.

mentions.claim_text: He asks God to pour out his spirit one more time on this generation and cause a major revival to flow over America, on the grounds that God said he was not done with America.
mentions.quote: Cause a major revival to flow over America
mentions.falsify_match: A national religious movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees miracles at a named healing ministry but that it is not what he wants to see, naming Acts chapter two, raising the dead and walking on water, while saying he loves it when people are healed of cancer.
mentions.quote: I want to saw Acts chapter 2, raise the dead, walking on water
mentions.falsify_match: Documented resurrections or comparable signs.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented. He distinguishes what he sees now from what he wants, which is worth recording.

mentions.claim_text: He describes people on the side of the road at a celebration of a coming, a marriage, tables with name tags on them and trees with tinsel and lights.
mentions.quote: I saw tables that had name tags on them
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to something identifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not; no reading is offered.

mentions.claim_text: He says a blue light will flow over water to kill bacteria and purify it, and that Elon Musk will produce a new multi-purpose apparatus which will be used in Gaza.
mentions.quote: Elon Musk is going to produce a new multi-purpose apparatus
mentions.falsify_match: A Musk backed water purification device deployed in Gaza.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. Ultraviolet water purification is existing technology, which lowers what the vision adds.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is time to get excited, that people who have been lost will be found and that they should watch what God does with hopeless cases in this end time harvest.
mentions.quote: Watch what God is about to do with this end-time harvest
mentions.falsify_match: Mass conversions.

mentions.claim_text: He declares a red wave over California and Los Angeles because enough is enough, and says there will be political backing against the governor over taxes.
mentions.quote: A red wave over California. Over LA
mentions.falsify_match: Conservative gains in Los Angeles and California.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether the audience knows the man at a named Californian centre with a grey beard, and says God is about to do something major in that church.
mentions.quote: God's about to do something major in that church
mentions.falsify_match: A revival at that church.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have been calling for revival and praying, that God will manifest his glory over their surrounding area as they asked, and that he will use them for the great outpouring.
mentions.quote: I will use them for this great outpouring
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised outpouring at that church.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees the church in the glory with unusual manifestations of the presence of God, and that there are some things they are tweaking and fixing that need correcting.
mentions.quote: unusual manifestations of the presence of God will manifest there
mentions.falsify_match: Documented unusual phenomena at that church.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The unfixed things clause means a non event can be attributed to them.

mentions.claim_text: He says that once they tweak this one little thing God will do something huge, and that the church will be put in the spotlight as a named church was, with a modern day Pensacola.
mentions.quote: once they tweak this little thing God's going to do something huge
mentions.falsify_match: A Pensacola scale revival at that church.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The little thing is never specified, so any absence is attributable to it.

mentions.claim_text: He says to let him flow with no preconceived idea of how each service should go, quoting the potter and the clay.
mentions.quote: No preconceived idea of how each service should be
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement of method.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has not seen this before and is excited about it, that he was able to go to Tulsa and California that night, and names a minister and what God will use him for.
mentions.quote: I haven't seen that before. It's neat what the Lord's about to do
mentions.falsify_match: A revival at the named places.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats a sung line that no matter the circumstance or what he feels or sees, the word is working mightily in him, and credits a named pastor with the song.
mentions.quote: the word is working mightily in me
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a sung declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.
